summary: Master liquidity risk management to strengthen funding resilience, improve contingency planning, and support compliant liquidity reporting. Enrol today.
lede: Liquidity Risk Management and Contingency Funding Planning helps professionals measure funding resilience, identify cash-flow mismatches, and respond to pressure before it becomes a crisis. Using liquidity gap analysis, stress scenarios, early warning indicators, LCR monitoring, and NSFR interpretation, it supports clearer and more defensible funding decisions. This course develops practical capability in liquidity stress testing, funding concentration analysis, contingency funding governance, and board reporting. You will also explore dashboard-based monitoring and template-driven reporting packs to assess liquidity profiles, translate stress results into executable actions, and produce reporting that senior decision-makers can use.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already work near treasury, funding, ALM, or liquidity governance and need a stronger practical grasp of stress testing, contingency planning, and reporting.
prerequisites: You should bring a working understanding of balance sheets, funding structures, and basic treasury or risk terminology. Familiarity with liquidity reporting, cash-flow forecasting, or ALCO materials will help you apply the exercises faster, but no programming or advanced quantitative background is required.
